Bones introduces his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and attempting to escape from a straitjacket while breakdancing.

Bones is back in his home city, London, where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card tricks and disappearing skills.

Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

description:
